biography: Unit CRA-5 is a Crimson Rapid Assist unit dispatched by the Crimson Empire's Pilot Welfare Division. Painted in the Empire's signature deep red livery, CRA-5 approaches every rescue with fierce loyalty and a surprisingly gentle bedside manner. The Crimson Empire's reputation is for strength, but CRA-5 proves they also look after their own. It arrives at distress calls with a booming 'Crimson Aid is on station—you're safe now!' and wastes no time getting fuel cells connected or repair kits deployed. CRA-5 considers every successful rescue a point of honor for the Empire.
name: CRA-5 'Cray'
